run_synthetic_correlations: run correlation analysis on synthetic data evaluations for a named dataset like aqua
run_sentinel_correlations: run correlation analysis on sentinel scores by passing the sentinel-scores flag
fetch_to_df: create a function that reads a whitespace-delimited CSV file and returns a pandas DataFrame
fetch_parturbation_mark: create a function that annotates a scores DataFrame with perturbation marks from a JSONL file
get_correlations: run the full correlation pipeline to compute statistics and save results to CSV files
